verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets offer some event-driven automation. Scheduled searches surface new web events [exa-docs-10], and real-time HTTP callbacks fire when items are added or enriched [exa-docs-21]. User-defined criteria and enrichment fields are then applied automatically to each matched item [exa-docs-28, exa-docs-15]. This is narrow, built-in automation tied to Websets, not a general user-defined rule engine where arbitrary conditions trigger arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: a general rules/condition-action builder, configurable actions beyond webhook delivery and enrichment, detailed docs on monitor/trigger configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these automations.
